summary.text: Pete Gertonson is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 7B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Charlie Shepherd (R).
Gertonson has held a local post as chairman of the Waha Water District and previously ran for the Idaho Legislature.

paragraphs.text: Pete Gertonson graduated from Lewiston High School in 1971 and earned a bachelor's degree from Lewis-Clark State College in 2010; his profession is listed as U.S. Post Office.
Ballotpedia lists his prior office as chairman of the Waha Water District.
Gertonson ran for Idaho House District 6A in 2012, losing the general election to Thyra K. Stevenson (R), 54.2 percent to 45.8 percent.
In 2014 he ran for Idaho State Senate District 6, losing to incumbent Dan Johnson (R), 63.4 percent to 36.6 percent.
He was one of Idaho's four superdelegates to the 2016 Democratic National Convention and was listed among superdelegates supporting Bernie Sanders.
